caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical snare drum resting on a flat brown surface. The drum has dark red wooden rims at the top and bottom, with tension ropes running vertically up and down its sides, secured with knots. The body of the drum is predominantly teal blue-green and features a large, detailed emblem in the center. The emblem shows a bald eagle with a white head, yellow beak, brown body, and outstretched wings; the eagle’s right talon grasps an olive branch with green leaves, while its left holds a bundle of arrows with white shafts and feathered ends. On the eagle's chest is a shield with a blue top band and vertical red and white stripes. Above the eagle's head is a cluster of stylized clouds in shades of white and light blue, with yellow rays and red tips radiating outward. The drawing is bordered by a plain, beige background and is signed “Stewart Wagner” in the lower right corner.
title: Drum
